text:
Claire: quick heads-up — ran into an a11y gap in the console table when doing multi-select + virtualization. NVDA/VoiceOver don’t announce totals or range selects reliably. Ravi: repro steps: open Jobs table, scroll, shift+click to select a block that spans offscreen rows. visual selection shows correct, but screen reader silence. :eyes: Jon: yep this is expected with virtualized DOM. selection state lives in JS but offscreen rows aren't in the DOM for SR to query. two pragmatic fixes: 1) aria-live region to announce counts/changes, 2) expose aria attributes on the visible rows and a summary element in the header. Sana: +1 on aria-live. also we should show a small persistent counter in the table header (left of filters) so keyboard users have a persistent reference. for mouse users a short toast is fine. Ravi: quick question — polite or assertive for the live region? if we update frequently during shift+drag it might be noisy. Jon: use polite. aria-atomic=true so SR reads the full message on change, and debounce updates (150-300ms) while the user is shift-selecting. assertive is too disruptive for selection flows. Sana: copy ideas for the toast / live annoucement: - "3 rows selected" (live) - Toast: "3 rows selected — Apply bulk action" with a CTA button. keep verbs simple. Claire: agree on copy. From component API POV, let's add props to our Table component: `selectionAnnouncement` (string | fn), `announceOnRangeSelect` (bool), and `liveDebounceMs` (number). default should be enabled for `announceOnRangeSelect`. Ravi: I can prototype in the component library. quick implementation note — add an offscreen region like: ```html
3 rows selected
``` // update the innerText on selection changes (debounced) Jon: small additional tips: - include `role="status"` fallback for older SRs. - when doing range selects, also expose `aria-rowcount` and `aria-rowindex` on visible rows so screen readers can calculate context. Sana: visual: when selection spans offscreen, show a subtle dashed gradient at top/bottom edges to indicate truncated selection? or just rely on counter + toast. we want to avoid extra visual noise. Claire: let's keep visuals minimal. persistent counter + toast for quick feedback + live region for SR. add an optional `selection-preview` toast that appears only when selecting > 20 rows to avoid spam. Ravi: noted. I'll open a draft PR against `components/table` with the live region util and a story demonstrating shift+select across virtualization. linking the branch once ready. :thumbsup: design-bot: uploaded screenshot — https://redwood-internal.s3/aws/mockups/selection-announce.png Jon: one more thing — ensure the live text is concise and localized. avoid long sentences; screen reader users want short actionable updates. i18n key: `table.selection_count` -> "{count} rows selected". Claire: perfect. thanks everyone. action items: Ravi -> draft PR + story; Jon -> review aria details; Sana -> approve copy & visuals. I'll add a short note to the design system changelog. Ravi: starting the PR now, ETA EOD. Sana: will draft toast copy variants and add to the storybook knobs. Jon: will review tomorrow morning. Claire: sweet — closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
